questions.solution_md:
Viyet teoremasiga ko'ra yig'indisi $-3$, ko'paytmasi $-10$ bo'lgan ikki sonni qidiramiz: bular $-5$ va $2$.

$$x^2-3x-10=(x-5)(x+2)$$
questions.mistake_note_md: Tipik xato: Ko'paytuvchilardagi sonlarning ishorasini teskari yozish: ildizlar bilan ko'paytuvchi ozod hadlarini adashtirish.

ru.solution_md:
Ищем два числа с суммой $-3$ и произведением $-10$ (теорема Виета): это $-5$ и $2$.

$$x^2-3x-10=(x-5)(x+2)$$
ru.mistake_note_md: Типичная ошибка: Записывать числа в скобках с противоположным знаком: путать корни и свободные члены множителей.

kaa.solution_md:
Viyet teoremasına kóre qosındısı $-3$, kóbeymesi $-10$ bolǵan eki sandı izleymiz: bular $-5$ hám $2$.

$$x^2-3x-10=(x-5)(x+2)$$
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tipik qátelik: Kóbeytiwshilerdegi sanlardıń belgisin teris jazıw: túbirler menen kóbeytiwshilerdiń bos aǵzaların shatastırıw.

en.stem_md:
Factor the expression.

$$x^2-3x-10$$
en.solution_md:
By Vieta's formulas we look for two numbers with sum $-3$ and product $-10$: they are $-5$ and $2$.

$$x^2-3x-10=(x-5)(x+2)$$
en.mistake_note_md: Typical mistake: Writing the numbers in the factors with the opposite sign (confusing roots with constants of the factors).

$$x^2-14x+48=(x-8)(x-6)$$
kaa.mistake_note_md: Tipik qátelik: Kóbeytiwshilerdegi sanlardıń belgisin teris jazıw: túbirler menen kóbeytiwshilerdiń bos aǵzaların shatastırıw.

en.stem_md:
Factor the expression.

$$x^2-14x+48$$
en.solution_md:
By Vieta's formulas we look for two numbers with sum $-14$ and product $48$: they are $-8$ and $-6$.

$$x^2-14x+48=(x-8)(x-6)$$
en.mistake_note_md: Typical mistake: Writing the numbers in the factors with the opposite sign (confusing roots with constants of the factors).
